fieldValues.title: Relations never define Container membership
fieldValues.normative_statement: A Relation of any type, including contains, MUST NOT cause an instance to appear in a Container's direct or effective membership.
fieldValues.rationale: RFC-034 [R4] (Change C), the consequence of rfc-decision-0750c62f: a Container is a declared selection on the expression plane and a Relation is a semantic claim. contains does not retire; it remains the part-of tree that navigation depth, layering and any tree walk are built on, and it must still be maintained. A Container is a bookmark over that tree.
